page.title: Role messages
page.infoSub: A message with a picture and one button per role: a click (or the reaction under it) gives or takes the role. Roles with rights are locked.

col.title: Title
col.rolesSub: One button per role; with an emoji also a reaction.

hint.offline: The bot is not connected right now – channels, roles and emojis are missing. Saving works again once it is online.
hint.manageRoles: The bot lacks the “Manage Roles” permission on this server – buttons and reactions cannot hand out a role then.

form.cantReact: The bot may not add reactions or read the history in this channel – the buttons work, the reactions do not.
form.title: Title
form.bodyPlaceholder: Click a button to get the role – another click takes it away.
form.imageSub: An https link to a picture; it shows large under the text.
form.colorSub: The bar on the left of the message. Off: the bot's colour.
form.rolesSub: One button per role (five per row). With an emoji the bot also adds a reaction under it.
form.noRoles: No role yet – “Add role” picks one.
form.addRoleFull: No more than {max} roles (Discord allows 25 buttons).
form.addRoleOffline: No role list without the bot.
form.label: Button text for @{role}

problem.titleLong: The title is longer than {title} characters.
problem.bodyLong: The text is longer than {body} characters.
problem.badImage: The image must be an https link.
problem.noRoles: At least one role is needed.
problem.tooManyReactions: At most {reactions} roles with an emoji (Discord allows 20 reactions).
problem.labelLong: The button text of @{role} is longer than {label} characters.
problem.duplicateEmoji: @{role} has the same emoji as another role.
problem.blockedRole: @{role} must not be handed out by a click.
problem.unknownRole: A role no longer exists on the server – please remove it.

error.no_guild: No server is set for this side.
error.unknown_channel: The channel no longer exists, or the bot may not write there.
error.bad_image: The image must be an https link.
error.no_roles: At least one role is needed.
error.too_many_roles: At most {roles} roles per message (Discord allows 25 buttons).
error.too_many_reactions: At most {reactions} roles with an emoji (Discord allows 20 reactions).
error.unknown_role: A role does not exist on the server (any more) – please remove it.
error.bad_emoji: The emoji of @{role} is not a single emoji.
error.unknown_emoji: The emoji of @{role} does not exist on this server.
error.duplicate_emoji: @{role} has the same emoji as another role.
error.privileged_role: @{role} carries rights and must not be handed out by a click: {reason}
error.not_found: This role message no longer exists.
error.post_failed: Discord did not accept the message: {message}
error.edit_failed: Discord did not accept the change: {message}
error.bot_offline: The bot is not connected or not on this server.

reason.officer: It is the officer role, pinged on new applications.
reason.permissions: The role has rights under Settings › Permissions.
reason.botCommands: The role may run bot commands.
reason.raider: It is the raider role of a category.
reason.roleSync: The role is part of the role sync between the servers.
reason.discordPermissions: The role has more Discord permissions than @everyone.
reason.manageRoles: The bot lacks the “Manage Roles” permission.
reason.integration: The role belongs to a bot or an integration.
reason.aboveBot: The role is above the bot's highest role.
reason.roster: The role belongs to the roster “{roster}” (raiders, trial or managers).

toast.reposted: Saved and posted anew – the old message is deleted.
toast.deletedGone: Deleted. The message in Discord was already gone.

delete.title: Delete role message?
delete.text: “{title}” is deleted – the message in Discord too. Roles already given stay.

modal.draftSub: Not saved yet – kept until you save or cancel.
